# Yes Bro

> The newspaper for your field. News, jobs, opportunities and research, every morning.
> No accounts required to read. No tracking of what you read.

Yes Bro is the first field-specific newspaper: news, jobs, opportunities and research for your field, every morning. No tracking.

Yes Bro publishes a free daily paper for each field. Every headline links to the original report. Readers pick a paper; there is no feed ranking and no tracking of what they read.

## Papers

- [Yes Bro AI](https://yesbrohq.com/ai/): Yes Bro AI is a free daily paper for anyone following artificial intelligence. It covers model launches, AI products, India AI news, funding…

- [Yes Bro Auto](https://yesbrohq.com/auto/): Yes Bro Auto covers Indian and global auto news: cars, EVs, two-wheelers, components and retail, with linked summaries and auto jobs.

- [Yes Bro Consulting](https://yesbrohq.com/consulting/): Yes Bro Consulting is a free daily paper for consultants and analysts, covering firm news, GCCs in India and consulting jobs.
- [Yes Bro Fashion](https://yesbrohq.com/fashion/): Yes Bro Fashion covers fashion, jewellery and textiles with an India-first lens, plus industry and jobs news in a free daily paper.
- [Yes Bro Finance](https://yesbrohq.com/finance/): Yes Bro Finance covers markets, banking and personal finance for India in a free daily paper. Summaries stay factual and dry, with links to …
- [Yes Bro Healing](https://yesbrohq.com/healing/): Yes Bro Healing is the daily field newspaper for Mindful Wholeness (https://mindfulwholeness.org/), Saurabh's healing practice site. It cove…
- [Yes Bro Health](https://yesbrohq.com/health/): Yes Bro Health is a free daily paper for doctors and health readers. It covers public health, medical research, pharma and health-tech news …
- [Yes Bro Higher Ed](https://yesbrohq.com/highered/): Yes Bro Higher Ed covers university admissions, study abroad, visas and scholarships for Indian students in a free daily paper.
- [Yes Bro Marketing](https://yesbrohq.com/marketing/): Yes Bro Marketing covers advertising, brand and media news plus marketing jobs in a free daily paper with linked summaries.
- [Yes Bro Packaging](https://yesbrohq.com/packaging/): Yes Bro Packaging is a free daily trade paper for packaging and plastics. It leads with plastic packaging and India news, then recycling, EP…
- [Yes Bro Real Estate](https://yesbrohq.com/realestate/): Yes Bro Real Estate is a free India-first trade paper for developers, brokers and property readers, covering housing, commercial, policy, RE…
- [Yes Bro Schools](https://yesbrohq.com/schools/): Yes Bro Schools is a free daily paper for senior-school students and teachers. It covers exams, scholarships, study skills and school policy…
- [Yes Bro Startups](https://yesbrohq.com/startups/): Yes Bro Startups follows Indian startup funding, founder news and product launches in a free daily paper, with links to the original reports…
- [Yes Bro Sustainability](https://yesbrohq.com/sustainability/): Yes Bro Sustainability follows ESG, climate and green industry news with sourced summaries and green jobs in a free daily paper.
- [Yes Bro UX & Design](https://yesbrohq.com/ux/): Yes Bro UX & Design is a free daily paper for product and visual designers. It covers UX research, UI, design systems, tools and design jobs…
